mileage.title: ELD mileage report
mileage.hint: Import the quarter's jurisdiction-mileage report from your ELD. One file per quarter; a newer file for a truck replaces its earlier rows, and nothing is deleted.
mileage.layoutLong: One row per truck and state
mileage.layoutWide: One row per truck, a column per state
mileage.columnsHint: We guessed from the headers. Fix anything wrong; your choice is remembered for this provider.
mileage.ready: {records} truck-and-state rows ready; {skipped} total or blank lines skipped
mileage.problems: {count} problem(s). Fix the file and choose it again; nothing is imported until every row is right.
mileage.unknownUnits: Trucks not in your fleet: {units}. Add them under Vehicles or correct the unit numbers in the file.
mileage.superseded: {records} earlier rows for the same trucks were replaced and kept for the audit trail.
mileage.rulesChecked: {count} fuel receipts re-checked against the miles
mileage.rulesOpened: {m001} with fuel but no miles for the truck (M001), {m002} bought in a state with no miles (M002)
mileage.mpgOutOfBand: Fleet MPG is outside the expected band (M003); miles or gallons may be missing.
mileage.none: No mileage report imported for this quarter yet.
mileage.xlsxNote: Export the report as CSV; spreadsheets (.xlsx) and PDFs are not read yet.

welcome.title: Welcome to your back office
welcome.body: Two minutes to see where things live. Receipts come in, we read and check them, you approve what needs you, and the quarter's IFTA numbers are ready for your preparer.

inbox.title: Inbox: where paperwork arrives
inbox.body: Drop receipts here, or let drivers send them from their phone. Each one is stored unchanged with a fingerprint and read twice by AI.

transactions.title: Transactions: the ledger
transactions.body: Every fuel purchase and expense, linked to its receipt. Open one to see both reads, the final value and who changed what.

review.title: Review: only what needs you
review.body: Anything the checks flagged waits here, sorted by deadline. Accept a read, type a value, or mark it unreadable. Nothing is invented.

ifta.title: Fuel & IFTA: the quarter
ifta.body: Import your fuel-card statement and ELD mileage. Fuel by state, miles by jurisdiction and the worksheet live here.

reports.title: Reports: what you hand over
reports.body: Transactions CSV and the IFTA worksheet, each stamped with a snapshot hash and labelled preliminary until reviewed.

vehicles.title: Vehicles & Drivers: set up once
vehicles.body: Add your trucks and the drivers who send receipts so every purchase lands on the right unit.

done.title: You are set
done.body: Start by adding your trucks, then upload this week's receipts. The checklist on Home keeps track.
